quizName: Hardest Questions in South dakota Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: How can you reduce fatigue while driving?
questions.explanation: Rest breaks help reduce fatigue during long trips. Caffeine and other stimulants can make fatigue worse because you may become very tired when they wear off. Weather conditions like wind, rain, and snow also increase fatigue.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To see if drivers behind you know you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds that show bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To see if drivers behind you know you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors to see vehicles approaching from behind. Make sure drivers see you and respond to your stop.

questions.question: When stopping your motorcycle with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Start slowing down earlier than normal.
Merge into smaller traffic gaps than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than normal.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. Extra weight makes the bike respond more slowly to your actions. It takes longer to speed up, slow down, and turn. Start slowing down earlier and look for larger gaps in traffic.

questions.question: When traveling at night, judging distances is:

options.text: The same as during the day.

questions.explanation: It is harder to judge distances at night than in daylight. Shadows and light help you see how far away objects are. Artificial lighting at night can distort or remove these helpful shadows and contrasts.

questions.question: Before taking over-the-counter medication and riding, you should:

options.text: Know that over-the-counter medicines are never very strong.
Be careful because the medication may affect your riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be careful because the medication may affect your riding.
questions.explanation: Many medications, including over-the-counter ones, have side effects that can make it unsafe to ride. Talk to your doctor about how any new medication may affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: Which material protects motorcycle riders best?
questions.explanation: Leather or sturdy synthetic materials provide the best protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: What is a benefit of reflective and brightly-colored helmets and clothing?

options.text: They should only be worn at night.
They help other drivers see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help other drivers see you.
questions.explanation: Brightly-colored or reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you on the road.

questions.question: What should you check before every ride?

options.text: That the paint is not peeling.

questions.explanation: Before every ride, test your brakes to make sure the brake lights turn on when you use them.

questions.question: To get the most protection from your helmet, it should:
questions.explanation: A helmet gives the best protection when it meets safety standards, fits snugly all the way around, and has no damage.

questions.question: What kind of boots or shoes should you wear when riding?

options.text: Boots or shoes that cover your ankles.
Shoes with long and loose laces.

questions.correctAnswerText: Boots or shoes that cover your ankles.
questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be low so they don't catch on surfaces. Tuck in shoelaces so they don't catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: When nearing a blind intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume that other drivers will properly yield the right-of-way.
Change your lane position to become more visible to other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your lane position to become more visible to other drivers.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, move to the part of your lane where other drivers can see you best.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors so other drivers can see you. This works day and night. Reflective clothing also helps.

questions.question: The faster you drink alcohol:

options.text: The faster the alcohol is removed from your body.
The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
The less the alcohol affects your body.

questions.correctAnswerText: The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
questions.explanation: Drinking alcohol quickly causes it to build up in your body. Your body removes about one drink per hour. If you drink more than one drink in an hour, alcohol will still be in your system after one hour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic laws for that area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Blind spots on motorcycles:

options.text: Should be consistently checked by riders.
Don't exist if the motorcycle has a rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be consistently checked by riders.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like all vehicles. Always turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Make this a habit.

questions.question: What should you do if you must ride on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, reduce your speed. Avoid sudden movements. Use both brakes smoothly.

questions.question: Improper braking:

options.text: Is a significant contributing factor to many motorcycle crashes.
Should not be a concern, since the motorcycle has two brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is a significant contributing factor to many motorcycle crashes.
questions.explanation: Improper braking causes many motorcycle crashes. Learning proper braking technique is essential for safe riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: To make it easier to be seen by other motorists, you should:
questions.explanation: Bright clothing makes other drivers see you. This works at any time of day.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should riders do?

options.text: All keep a safe distance between motorcycles.
Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about the distance between riders.

questions.correctAnswerText: All keep a safe distance between motorcycles.
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, use a staggered formation. This lets riders stay close together while keeping safe distances between motorcycles.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, what matters most?
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important thing to think about when buying a helmet.

questions.question: If you borrow a motorcycle, what should you do first?

options.text: Assume the controls are in the same places as your motorcycle.
Take it out on the highway right away.
Learn how it works in a safe, controlled area.

questions.correctAnswerText: Learn how it works in a safe, controlled area.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, find out where all the controls are. Practice riding it in a safe area before going on the road.

questions.question: What gives you the best chance of surviving a crash?
questions.explanation: A DOT-approved helmet gives the best head and neck protection. Wearing a good-quality helmet that is fastened securely is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash.

questions.question: What is most important when buying a motorcycle helmet?
questions.explanation: Protection is the first thing to consider when buying a helmet. Choose a helmet that fits well, fastens securely, and is DOT-approved.
